say:3:1220301003:0.text: If you don't have enough fingers, have someone else help you.
say:3:1220301003:0.source_cn: 你自己的手指头要是不够掰，赶紧找边上的人再借一只手。

say:4:1220301004:0.text: Yes, sir! I'll use my toes, too.

say:5:1220301005:0.text: You got a smart mouth, don't you? Where's the fella that's going to buy the rat poison?
say:5:1220301005:0.source_cn: 别耍聪明。买老鼠药的人什么时候回来？

say:6:1220301006:0.text: Sir, that's me! I just finished my work... I'll head out right now.
say:6:1220301006:0.source_cn: 二当家！我刚忙完……我马上去！

say:7:1220301007:0.text: Remember this time! We need rat poison, not rat pellets. If you buy rodent feed again, that'll be your dinner for the rest of the year!
say:7:1220301007:0.source_cn: 这回要是再买成老鼠饲料，那玩意就是你未来一年的晚餐！

say:8:1220301008:0.text: You new fish don't know anything! How are you going to help Sonja if you're all as dumb as a snail?
say:8:1220301008:0.source_cn: 这些笨手笨脚的新人，什么时候才能给索尼娅分忧？

say:10:1220301009:0.text: You know, Lucca, it takes a very special person to find rodent feed in a dingy place like this.
say:10:1220301009:0.source_cn: 能找到卖老鼠饲料的地方，也是一种本领啊，卢卡。

say:13:1220301011:0.text: A rodent infestation just broke out in Rustport. It's got everyone on edge.
say:13:1220301011:0.source_cn: 这几天锈锚港在闹鼠患，搞得大家都人心惶惶。
say:13:1220301011:0.male: A rodent infestation just broke out in Rustport. It's got everyone on edge.
say:13:1220301011:0.female: A rodent infestation just broke out in Rustport. It's got everyone on edge.

say:14:1220301012:0.text: I'm not talking about your two lackeys there. Rats have been coming out of the woodwork, and people are worried that a new plague might start.
say:14:1220301012:0.source_cn: ——不是指你的两个跟班，而是那些可能引发新一轮鼠疫的耗子。
say:14:1220301012:0.male: I'm not talking about your two lackeys there. Rats have been coming out of the woodwork, and people are worried that a new plague might start.
say:14:1220301012:0.female: I'm not talking about your two lackeys there. Rats have been coming out of the woodwork, and people are worried that a new plague might start.

say:16:1220301013:0.text: Was there ever a plague in Rustport before?
say:16:1220301013:0.source_cn: 锈锚港曾经爆发过鼠疫吗？

say:17:1220301014:0.text: Yes, there was a plague related to a dark mage.
say:17:1220301014:0.source_cn: 那场鼠疫与黑魔法师有关。

say:18:1220301015:0.text: It's said that the dark mage was experimenting with disease-inducing mice, but they escaped and were later eaten by sea birds. These birds were then captured by hunters and fishermen and served at dinner tables all over Rustport.
say:18:1220301015:0.source_cn: 黑魔法师培育出了致病的老鼠，没想到那群老鼠逃出笼子，被...

say:19:1220301016:0.text: Death lurked in every bite, and finally, it got out of control.
say:19:1220301016:0.source_cn: 死亡潜藏在食欲中，最后……一发不可收拾。

say:20:1220301017:0.text: Many people died during that time. It's been more than a century, but that fear still lingers in Rustport.
say:20:1220301017:0.source_cn: 当时死了不少人，虽然过去一百多年了，但那种恐惧还留在大...

say:21:1220301018:0.text: A dark mage, huh? Yes, they were indeed rampant during those days. I didn't know that even Rustport was affected.
say:21:1220301018:0.source_cn: 黑魔法师啊……那个年代，黑魔法师的确很猖狂，没想到连锈...

say:22:1220301019:0.text: Mr. Lucca, what's your plan going forward?
say:22:1220301019:0.source_cn: 卢卡先生，你现在打算怎么办？

say:23:1220301020:0.text: Right now, the rats have ruined a couple of warehouses full of supplies. I'm taking my men to see what we have left, do some inventory, and then buy supplies to fill the gaps.
say:23:1220301020:0.source_cn: 老鼠糟蹋了好几个仓库，我正带人挨个清点，之后好统一采购...

say:24:1220301021:0.text: The problem is our new recruits are as dumb as a starfish. Progress is slow.
say:24:1220301021:0.source_cn: 但那几个新入伙的，脑袋不太灵光……进度堪忧。

say:25:1220301022:0.text: I've been busy since yesterday, and there's still one place I haven't gone to yet.
say:25:1220301022:0.source_cn: 从昨天忙到现在，我还有一处没来得及去。

say:37:1220301032:1.text: Mr. Lucca, where is the warehouse you mentioned? Chippy and I will go help.

say:2:1220304001:0.source_cn: 你在说什么？少坑我！哪有吃鱼的老鼠啊？

say:10:1220304005:0.source_cn: 啊，是魔法师大人家的小可爱。真想摸一摸！

say:10:1220304005:0.female: Oh, you're that cute rodent that follows the mage around. I've been wondering what your cheeks feel like.

say:11:1220304006:0.text: But I don't have time to think about that now! If Lucca knew that all the fish were gone, he's gonna be furious.

say:12:1220304007:0.male: Luckily, he's not here right now. I need to fix this before he finds out.
say:12:1220304007:0.female: Luckily, he's not here right now. I need to fix this before he finds out.

say:14:1220304009:1.source_cn: 你看这个，是卢卡交给我们的。

say:16:1220304011:0.text: Please! Don't tell Lucca what happened.
say:16:1220304011:0.source_cn: 求求你们！千万别告诉二当家！
say:16:1220304011:0.male: Please! Don't tell Lucca what happened.
say:16:1220304011:0.female: Please! Don't tell Lucca what happened.

say:17:1220304012:1.text: I can't make any more mistakes this month. I've already used up all the chances I've been given, and the month isn't even halfway through!

say:19:1220304014:0.text: Tell us about the fish you just mentioned.
say:19:1220304014:0.source_cn: 你们刚才提到的鱼是怎么回事？

say:20:1220304015:1.text: We always buy fish from this guy, and he usually delivers his freshest catch.

say:20:1220304015:1.male: We always buy fish from this guy, and he usually delivers his freshest catch.
say:20:1220304015:1.female: We always buy fish from this guy, and he usually delivers his freshest catch.

say:21:1220304016:0.source_cn: 可是今天我来拿鱼的时候，鱼没了，只有一地臭烘烘的鱼血和鱼鳞！

say:21:1220304016:0.female: But when I came to pick up the fish today, the catch was gone. There was only some stinkin' fish blood and a few scales on the ground!

say:24:1220304017:0.female: I put out the fish for you. How is it my fault that they disappeared?

say:2:1220314001:0.female: Everything around the warehouse was normal. The guard didn't seem too suspicious, but he had a bad attitude.

say:3:1220314002:0.female: He had a shifty look in his eyes when he was talking to us.

say:0:1220318001:0.female: Ill-bred louts! They've chewed up everything!

say:0:1220319001:0.female: They run so fast! We're going to lose them!

say:0:1220320001:0.text: We've lost them. Let's ask around and see if anyone saw anything.

say:0:1220320001:0.male: We've lost them. Let's ask around and see if anyone saw anything.
say:0:1220320001:0.female: We've lost them. Let's ask around and see if anyone saw anything.

say:1:1220321002:0.text: Not a monster, but a giant rat!

say:2:1220321003:0.text: A giant rat is a monster!
say:2:1220321003:0.source_cn: 那么大的老鼠就是怪物！

say:1:1220322001:0.text: My brother insisted that those monsters were just a group of big rats!

say:1:1220322001:0.male: My brother insisted that those monsters were just a group of big rats!
say:1:1220322001:0.female: My brother insisted that those monsters were just a group of big rats!

choice_prompt:3:1220322002.female: How can rats get that big? They can swallow my cat in my bite!

say:5:1220322004:0.text: Are you trying to catch those things? Yes, please do! For our safety and the safety of all our cats!

say:5:1220322004:0.female: Are you trying to catch those things? Yes, please do! For our safety and the safety of all our cats!

say:0:1220323001:0.text: I think the rats knocked over these. They should be going in that direction.

say:0:1220323001:0.female: I think the rats knocked over these. They should be going in that direction.

say:0:1220324001:0.male: They went down here. Let's go take a look.
say:0:1220324001:0.female: They went down here. Let's go take a look.

say:2:1220325001:0.text: I can feel it. There's strong evil magic about.
say:2:1220325001:0.source_cn: 我感觉到了，这里有浓浓的邪恶魔力。
say:2:1220325001:0.male: I can feel it. There's strong evil magic about.
say:2:1220325001:0.female: I can feel it. There's strong evil magic about.

say:3:1220325002:0.text: I felt it a little on the rats, but now, in this cramped space, I can sense it very clearly.
say:3:1220325002:0.source_cn: 那些老鼠身上多多少少也带着一点，在这个空间局促的地方，...
say:3:1220325002:0.male: I felt it a little on the rats, but now, in this cramped space, I can sense it very clearly.
say:3:1220325002:0.female: I felt it a little on the rats, but now, in this cramped space, I can sense it very clearly.

say:4:1220325003:0.text: So they're monsters created by magic? Who could have done this, and why?
say:4:1220325003:0.source_cn: 哎？那它们是用魔法制造出来的怪物咯？会是谁干的呢……为...

say:5:1220325004:1.source_cn: 唔……按照血薇帮和水鬼帮的恩怨来看，水鬼帮的可能性大一点。

say:6:1220325005:0.text: But do they have someone who knows dark magic? And this option is out of character for them... If they want to get back at the Whispers, there are other ways.
say:6:1220325005:0.source_cn: 但是，他们有这种深谙黑魔法的人吗？而且动机也很模糊……...

say:0:1220326001:0.male: Are these human footprints? Why are they in the sewers?
say:0:1220326001:0.female: Are these human footprints? Why are they in the sewers?

say:0:1220327001:0.source_cn: 这边没什么特别的东西。

say:2:1220328001:1.source_cn: 主人你看，我捡到了这个！

say:3:1220328002:1.text: This coin is similar to the one Lucca gave us.
say:3:1220328002:1.source_cn: 这枚硬币，和卢卡交给我们的硬币很像！
say:3:1220328002:1.male: This coin is similar to the one Lucca gave us.
say:3:1220328002:1.female: This coin is similar to the one Lucca gave us.

say:4:1220328003:1.male: This coin is used by the Carmine Whispers to identify themselves with other members. How did this one end up here?
say:4:1220328003:1.female: This coin is used by the Carmine Whispers to identify themselves with other members. How did this one end up here?

say:5:1220328004:1.text: Let's keep it safe for now. We give it to Lucca and find its owner later.
say:5:1220328004:1.source_cn: 先收起来吧，回头交给卢卡，说不定能找到失主。
say:5:1220328004:1.male: Let's keep it safe for now. We give it to Lucca and find its owner later.
say:5:1220328004:1.female: Let's keep it safe for now. We give it to Lucca and find its owner later.

say:9:1220328006:1.text: Can you give that coin back to me...?
say:9:1220328006:1.male: Can you give that coin back to me...?
say:9:1220328006:1.female: Can you give that coin back to me...?

say:4:1220329004:0.text: It's a coin that someone gave me. It's precious to me.
say:4:1220329004:0.source_cn: 那是一位叔叔交给我的硬币，是我的宝物。
say:4:1220329004:0.male: It's a coin that someone gave me. It's precious to me.
say:4:1220329004:0.female: It's a coin that someone gave me. It's precious to me.

say:6:1220329005:0.text: Is it someone from the Carmine Whispers?
say:6:1220329005:0.source_cn: 你口中的那位叔叔，是血薇帮的人吗？

say:7:1220329006:0.text: If not, this coin probably doesn't belong to that person either, and we can't give it to you.
say:7:1220329006:0.source_cn: 如果不是，这枚硬币恐怕也不是那位叔叔的所有物。我们更不...

say:9:1220329008:0.text: No, I can't tell you ... Just give me back the coin!
say:9:1220329008:0.source_cn: 不……我不该说……快把硬币还给我！

say:10:1220329009:0.text: You're bad people! Give it back!
say:10:1220329009:0.male: You're bad people! Give it back!
say:10:1220329009:0.female: You're bad people! Give it back!

say:11:1220329010:1.text: Keep your voice down, or you'll attract the rats here!
say:11:1220329010:1.source_cn: 你的声音小一点，会把老鼠引来的！

say:15:1220329003:0.source_cn: 我没撒谎，那是我的东西！

say:0:1220330001:0.text: There are more than before! Chippy, protect the magister!
say:0:1220330001:0.source_cn: 数量比刚才还要多！满满，保护好主人！
say:0:1220330001:0.male: There are more than before! Chippy, protect the magister!
say:0:1220330001:0.female: There are more than before! Chippy, protect the magister!

say:2:1220331001:0.text: The little girl ran away... I hope she's okay. I was so focused on the rats that I didn't notice her.
say:2:1220331001:0.source_cn: 啊，那个小女孩跑掉了……她没受伤吧？刚才只顾着摆脱老鼠...

say:3:1220331002:0.text: How did she get here in the first place...?
say:3:1220331002:0.source_cn: 她是怎么跑到这里来的呢？

say:4:1220331003:0.text: By the way, do you think she was talking about Tucker earlier? The name she was about to mention...
say:4:1220331003:0.source_cn: 话说，那个小女孩提到的名字，会不会是塔克？

say:5:1220331004:0.text: Chippy heard it too. The name starts with the letter <style="highlight">"T"</style>.

say:6:1220331005:1.source_cn: 或许是我们听错了，也可能是<style=stress>...

say:7:1220331006:0.text: Since there are no other clues at the moment, why don't we go back and ask him?
say:7:1220331006:0.source_cn: 反正眼下也没有其他线索，我们不如回去问问他？
say:7:1220331006:0.male: Since there are no other clues at the moment, why don't we go back and ask him?
say:7:1220331006:0.female: Since there are no other clues at the moment, why don't we go back and ask him?

say:9:1220331007:1.text: Hmm... That's right. Tucker is acting a little suspicious. Let's go ask the other members of the Carmine Whispers.

say:9:1220331007:1.male: Hmm... That's right. Tucker is acting a little suspicious. Let's go ask the other members of the Carmine Whispers.
say:9:1220331007:1.female: Hmm... That's right. Tucker is acting a little suspicious. Let's go ask the other members of the Carmine Whispers.

say:10:1220331008:1.text: The lady from before might be willing to tell us some information.
say:10:1220331008:1.source_cn: 之前那位冒冒失失的女士，说不定愿意告诉我们一些情报。
say:10:1220331008:1.male: The lady from before might be willing to tell us some information.
say:10:1220331008:1.female: The lady from before might be willing to tell us some information.

say:11:1220331009:1.text: She may still be shopping near the fish market. Let's go find her.
say:11:1220331009:1.source_cn: 她可能还在鱼市附近采购，我们去找找她吧。
say:11:1220331009:1.male: She may still be shopping near the fish market. Let's go find her.
say:11:1220331009:1.female: She may still be shopping near the fish market. Let's go find her.

narration:0:1220332001:0.female: You're concerned about the little girl you met in the sewers.

narration:1:1220332002:0.female: You go look for members of the Carmine Whispers to ask about her and the coin...

say:1:1220333001:1.text: Thanks to you, the fish were delivered on time. The boss was happy, and I was spared an earful.
say:1:1220333001:1.source_cn: 多亏你们，那些鱼才能按时送给大当家，我也免遭一顿骂。
say:1:1220333001:1.male: Thanks to you, the fish were delivered on time. The boss was happy, and I was spared an earful.
say:1:1220333001:1.female: Thanks to you, the fish were delivered on time. The boss was happy, and I was spared an earful.

say:2:1220333002:1.text: What can I do for you? Do you need help with something?
say:2:1220333002:1.source_cn: 你们找我是有什么事吗？我很乐意帮忙！
say:2:1220333002:1.male: What can I do for you? Do you need help with something?
say:2:1220333002:1.female: What can I do for you? Do you need help with something?

choice_prompt:3:1220333002.text: What can I do for you? Do you need help with something?

choice_prompt:3:1220333002.male: What can I do for you? Do you need help with something?
choice_prompt:3:1220333002.female: What can I do for you? Do you need help with something?

say:4:1220333003:0.text: Yeah, it's one of our coins. What about it?
say:4:1220333003:0.source_cn: 哦，这是我们的硬币。有什么想问的呢？
say:4:1220333003:0.male: Yeah, it's one of our coins. What about it?
say:4:1220333003:0.female: Yeah, it's one of our coins. What about it?

say:6:1220333004:0.text: Do you know whose coin this belongs to?
say:6:1220333004:0.source_cn: 你知道这是谁的硬币吗？

say:7:1220333005:1.text: Well... Actually, all coins look the same. If you ask me that, it's hard to tell.
say:7:1220333005:1.source_cn: 嗯……其实硬币都长得一样，你这么问，我也——

say:8:1220333006:0.text: Wait, this coin is marked on the back.
say:8:1220333006:0.source_cn: 等等，这枚硬币的背面做了记号。

say:10:1220333008:1.text: Look, it's not that obvious. There's a small knife mark here.
say:10:1220333008:1.source_cn: 喏，不太明显，是用小刀刻上去的。

say:11:1220333009:1.text: Some members do this to distinguish their coins from others.
say:11:1220333009:1.source_cn: 为了将自己的硬币和其他人的区分开，有些成员会这么做。

say:12:1220333010:0.text: I remember someone lost the coin before. What was his name again? I think his name started with a "T".
say:12:1220333010:0.source_cn: 话说，之前好像有人把硬币弄丢了。我记得那个人叫……塔…...

say:15:1220333012:1.text: Yes! Tucker! You know him? This might be his.
say:15:1220333012:1.source_cn: 对！塔克！箱子·塔克。你们竟然认识他？这说不定是他的硬币。
say:15:1220333012:1.male: Yes! Tucker! You know him? This might be his.
say:15:1220333012:1.female: Yes! Tucker! You know him? This might be his.

say:16:1220333013:0.text: We don't really know him, but thanks for the information, Miss Sana.
say:16:1220333013:0.source_cn: 算不上认识……总之，你提供了很重要的情报，谢谢你，赛娜小姐。

say:17:1220333014:0.text:

choice_prompt:13:1220354010.female: The others were able to escape, but I was caught and taken to a very scary person...

say:15:1220354011:0.text: His eyes were green and glowing!
say:15:1220354011:0.source_cn: 他的眼睛是绿色的……还发着光！
say:15:1220354011:0.male: His eyes were green and glowing!
say:15:1220354011:0.female: His eyes were green and glowing!

say:17:1220354015:1.text: The scary man said he could heal my scars.
say:17:1220354015:1.source_cn: 那个可怕的人说，能帮我治好身上的疤痕。

say:18:1220354016:1.text: Every couple of days, he would force me to drink a jar of sticky green slime. It tasted bitter and had a very fishy smell. It smelled worse than the sewers here.
say:18:1220354016:1.source_cn: 每隔几天，他都会逼我喝下一罐粘稠的绿色液体，很苦……非...

say:19:1220354017:0.text: But the scars on my body started to heal day by day, and finally, they all disappeared.
say:19:1220354017:0.source_cn: 但是，我身上的伤疤，竟然真的一天天好了起来，最后完全消失了。

say:20:1220354018:0.text: Was he a good person then?

say:21:1220354019:1.text: If it wasn't for that <style="stress">incident</style>, I would've thought he was a good person too.
say:21:1220354019:1.source_cn: 如果不是发生了<style=stress>那件事</s...

say:22:1220354020:1.text: The guards were not there one day, so I tried to escape, but I accidentally knocked over a big rock and it fell on my foot.
say:22:1220354020:1.source_cn: 那天看守都不在，我想逃跑，却不小心被石头砸伤了脚。

say:23:1220354021:0.text: During this time, several mice crawled over and licked at my wounds. They must've been starving or something.
say:23:1220354021:0.source_cn: 这时候几只老鼠爬过来，舔我的伤口。它们……好像饿疯了。

say:24:1220354022:1.text: Was this when you discovered that you could control the rats?
say:24:1220354022:1.source_cn: 我好像猜到了……是不是从那时候起，你发现自己可以控制老鼠？

say:25:1220354023:0.text: Yes... With their help, I was finally able to escape from that terrible cave.
say:25:1220354023:0.source_cn: 是的……在它们的帮助下，我终于逃离了那个可怕的山洞。

say:26:1220354024:1.text: In stories, princesses are often protected by small animals. I thought... I was about to become a princess.
say:26:1220354024:1.source_cn: 在故事里，公主不是常常被小动物保护吗？我以为……自己差...

say:27:1220354025:0.text: But after returning to Rustport, I found that the mice were getting bigger and bigger. They had become monsters in the end...
say:27:1220354025:0.source_cn: 可是回到锈锚港以后，我发现老鼠们越来越大。它们……变成...

say:28:1220354026:1.text: Fortunately, you were able to control the rats and prevent more serious consequences.
say:28:1220354026:1.source_cn: 幸好你能够控制这些老鼠，才没有引发更严重的恶果。

say:30:1220354028:0.text: I discovered that the animals that ate the rats started to change. They would slowly morph into horrible-looking rats themselves! And they didn't listen to me at all!
say:30:1220354028:0.source_cn: 我发现……吃掉那些老鼠尸体的动物，血肉会像海浪一样翻涌...

say:31:1220354029:1.text: It must be the green liquid you drank earlier... It has to be some kind of magical potion.
say:31:1220354029:1.source_cn: 你之前喝下的绿色液体……恐怕是一种特殊的魔药。

say:32:1220354030:0.text: According to the stories I've read, some Graveborns were capable of using dreadful magic that could alter the flesh and blood of living beings... I didn't expect it to be true...
say:32:1220354030:0.source_cn: 书上说，有些亡灵掌握着可怕的魔法，能够改变生物的血肉之...

say:33:1220354031:0.text: I was thinking that if these new rats licked my wounds like the others, they would behave themselves and start listening to me.
say:33:1220354031:0.source_cn: 我在想，是不是只要舔了我的伤口，那些老鼠也会乖乖听话，...

say:34:1220354032:0.text: So, I tried to feed them some of my blood in the hopes that they would stop causing trouble in the city.
say:34:1220354032:0.source_cn: 所以，我尝试给它们喝自己的血，希望它们不要再去地面上作乱。

say:35:1220354033:0.text: But it didn't work... and now I can't even control myself!
say:35:1220354033:0.source_cn: 但是，不止是老鼠……我甚至无法控制我自己！

say:36:1220354034:0.text: I want to bite things... I want to destroy... I want to crawl around like a rat! I feel like I'm about to turn into a monster!
say:36:1220354034:0.source_cn: 想要撕咬……想要破坏……想要趴在地上，像老鼠一样爬行！...

say:37:1220354035:1.text: With the magister here, you won't turn into a monster! He'll definitely help you!
say:37:1220354035:1.source_cn: 有主人在，你不会变成怪物！主人能帮你！
say:37:1220354035:1.male: With the magister here, you won't turn into a monster! He'll definitely help you!
say:37:1220354035:1.female: With the magister here, you won't turn into a monster! She'll definitely help you!

say:38:1220354036:1.text: Maybe if we met earlier... but it's too late now...
say:38:1220354036:1.source_cn: 如果……能早一点……但是……现在已经……太迟了……

say:39:1220354037:0.text: I can feel... a change coming. Maybe it will be tonight when the moon sets... or tomorrow when the sun rises...
say:39:1220354037:0.source_cn: 我能感觉到……变化要来了。也许是今晚月亮落下的时候，也...

say:40:1220354038:1.text: I don't want to hurt others... After I die, I want to find Dura's embrace...
say:40:1220354038:1.source_cn: 我不想伤害别人……我想在死后，去艾雅庇护的地方……

say:43:1220354041:1.text: I don't want to become a monster... I don't want to hurt people... I don't want to hurt Mr. Tucker...
say:43:1220354041:1.source_cn: 我不想……变成怪物……去伤害别人……去伤害塔克先生！
say:43:1220354041:1.male: I don't want to become a monster... I don't want to hurt people... I don't want to hurt Mr. Tucker...
say:43:1220354041:1.female: I don't want to become a monster... I don't want to hurt people... I don't want to hurt Mr. Tucker...

say:44:1220354042:0.text: Oh, no! Her body is starting to mutate! Hold on! Don't give up!
say:44:1220354042:0.source_cn: 不好！她的身体开始变异了！坚持住……不要放弃啊！
say:44:1220354042:0.male: Oh, no! Her body is starting to mutate! Hold on! Don't give up!
say:44:1220354042:0.female: Oh, no! Her body is starting to mutate! Hold on! Don't give up!

say:45:1220354043:0.text: The nights are so cold in Rustport. I want to go somewhere warm.
say:45:1220354043:0.source_cn: 锈锚港的夜晚很冷，我想去一个温暖的地方。
say:45:1220354043:0.male: The nights are so cold in Rustport. I want to go somewhere warm.
say:45:1220354043:0.female: The nights are so cold in Rustport. I want to go somewhere warm.

say:46:1220354044:1.source_cn: 求求你们……把我送去那里吧。

choice:13:0:1.text: What did this person look like?
choice:13:0:1.male: What did this person look like?
choice:13:0:1.female: What did this person look like?

say:48:1220354013:0.text: I-I don't know. It was a dark cave... I remember there were jars filled with green slime or something.
say:48:1220354013:0.source_cn: 我……我不清楚，好像是一个阴暗的山洞里……我记得有许多...

say:49:1220354014:1.text: Dark cave... green slime... sounds like the Graveborn to me.
say:49:1220354014:1.source_cn: 阴暗……绿色……让我想到了亡灵。

choice:7:0:1.male: Oh, you're okay. You're not a monster.
choice:7:0:1.female: Oh, you're okay. You're not a monster.

say:2:1220356001:0.text: Now that our princess is gone... As the source of all this, there shouldn't be any more giant rats appearing...
say:2:1220356001:0.source_cn: 现在公主消失了……作为这一切的源头，之后应该不会再出现...
say:2:1220356001:0.male: Now that our princess is gone... As the source of all this, there shouldn't be any more giant rats appearing...
say:2:1220356001:0.female: Now that our princess is gone... As the source of all this, there shouldn't be any more giant rats appearing...

She was kind and brave, and she really could talk to animals!

say:4:1220356003:0.text: She may have been an orphan, but to me, she was a young princess from a fairy tale.
say:4:1220356003:0.source_cn: 我知道她是孤儿！但是对我来说，她就是童话故事里的小公主！
say:4:1220356003:0.male: She may have been an orphan, but to me, she was a young princess from a fairy tale.
say:4:1220356003:0.female: She may have been an orphan, but to me, she was a young princess from a fairy tale.

say:5:1220356004:0.text: Darn it! I don't even know her name!
say:5:1220356004:0.source_cn: 可恶……结果我连她的名字都不知道！
say:5:1220356004:0.male: Darn it! I don't even know her name!
say:5:1220356004:0.female: Darn it! I don't even know her name!

say:7:1220356006:1.text: I'm not crying! The fumes from the sewers are just getting to me!
say:7:1220356006:1.source_cn: 我没有哭！是下水道的气体太刺激了！

say:8:1220356007:0.text: I don't have time to cry... I want to find those spineless Graveborns who did this to her!
say:8:1220356007:0.source_cn: 我可没时间在这里哭……我要找到那些做坏事的亡灵！

say:11:1220356009:0.source_cn: 虽然他在等着我们……但是……要怎么开口呢……

say:11:1220356009:0.female: Chippy knows he's waiting for us, but what should we say when we see him...

say:12:1220356010:0.text: We have some time... Let's think of something on the way back...
say:12:1220356010:0.source_cn: 主人，还有一些时间，回去的路上边走边想吧……
say:12:1220356010:0.male: We have some time... Let's think of something on the way back...
say:12:1220356010:0.female: We have some time... Let's think of something on the way back...

say:0:1220357001:0.text: Should I tell Tucker the truth?
say:0:1220357001:0.source_cn: 到底要不要把真相告诉塔克呢……
say:0:1220357001:0.male: Should I tell Tucker the truth?
say:0:1220357001:0.female: Should I tell Tucker the truth?

say:1:1220358001:0.source_cn: 那个女孩呢？怎么没看见她。

say:2:1220358002:1.text: Didn't she come back with you?
say:2:1220358002:1.male: Didn't she come back with you?
say:2:1220358002:1.female: Didn't she come back with you?

choice_prompt:3:1220358002.male: Didn't she come back with you?
choice_prompt:3:1220358002.female: Didn't she come back with you?

say:5:1220358004:1.text: People like us know that fate is unfair, and there's no point in blaming the gods.
say:5:1220358004:1.source_cn: 像我们这种人，早就知道命运不公平，也从没想着埋怨神明。
say:5:1220358004:1.male: People like us know that fate is unfair, and there's no point in blaming the gods.
say:5:1220358004:1.female: People like us know that fate is unfair, and there's no point in blaming the gods.

say:6:1220358005:1.text: But this time... life is just too unfair.
say:6:1220358005:1.source_cn: 但是……这次也太不公平了。
say:6:1220358005:1.male: But this time... life is just too unfair.
say:6:1220358005:1.female: But this time... life is just too unfair.

say:7:1220358010:1.text: Thanks, magister. I think I know what I should do next.
say:7:1220358010:1.source_cn: 大魔法师，无论如何，谢谢你。我想，我知道自己接下来该做...
say:7:1220358010:1.male: Thanks, magister. I think I know what I should do next.
say:7:1220358010:1.female: Thanks, magister. I think I know what I should do next.

say:9:1220358006:1.text: She just left...? She didn't even say where she was going?
say:9:1220358006:1.source_cn: 她走了……？也没说去哪里吗？
say:9:1220358006:1.male: She just left...? She didn't even say where she was going?
say:9:1220358006:1.female: She just left...? She didn't even say where she was going?

choice_prompt:10:1220358006.female: She just left...? She didn't even say where she was going?

say:11:1220358007:1.text: What? Why? Does she hate me or something?
say:11:1220358007:1.source_cn: 为什么不告诉我……那孩子讨厌我吗？
say:11:1220358007:1.male: What? Why? Does she hate me or something?
say:11:1220358007:1.female: What? Why? Does she hate me or something?

say:12:1220358008:1.text: No, I get it… No one likes a guy who looks like this. My daughter hates me too, I think…
say:12:1220358008:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈……也、也是……我这副模样，没有哪个孩子会喜欢吧...
say:12:1220358008:1.male: No, I get it… No one likes a guy who looks like this. My daughter hates me too, I think…
say:12:1220358008:1.female: No, I get it… No one likes a guy who looks like this. My daughter hates me too, I think…

say:13:1220358009:1.text: But she's alone. Where can she go? If she goes into the mountains, she'll get killed by the wild animals there. No, I have to go find her!
say:13:1220358009:1.source_cn: 可她一个人，能去哪？她可别走进深山里被野兽吃掉了。我得...
say:13:1220358009:1.male: But she's alone. Where can she go? If she goes into the mountains, she'll get killed by the wild animals there. No, I have to go find her!
say:13:1220358009:1.female: But she's alone. Where can she go? If she goes into the mountains, she'll get killed by the wild animals there. No, I have to go find her!

choice:10:0:1.male: She doesn't want you to know.
choice:10:0:1.female: She doesn't want you to know.

narration:0:1220359001:1.text: A few days later, you decide to check on Tucker before heading into the warehouse.
narration:0:1220359001:1.male: A few days later, you decide to check on Tucker before heading into the warehouse.
narration:0:1220359001:1.female: A few days later, you decide to check on Tucker before heading into the warehouse.

say:3:1220360001:1.text: Tucker isn't here, and he's no longer in charge of guarding the warehouse.
say:3:1220360001:1.source_cn: 塔克没在这，现在不负责看守仓库了。
say:3:1220360001:1.male: Tucker isn't here, and he's no longer in charge of guarding the warehouse.
say:3:1220360001:1.female: Tucker isn't here, and he's no longer in charge of guarding the warehouse.

say:4:1220360002:1.text: Are you his friends? I didn't know he had friends. That guy never talks to people. I always thought he was mute.
say:4:1220360002:1.source_cn: 你们是塔克的朋友？我不知道他还有朋友哎，那个人很少和别...
say:4:1220360002:1.male: Are you his friends? I didn't know he had friends. That guy never talks to people. I always thought he was mute.
say:4:1220360002:1.female: Are you his friends? I didn't know he had friends. That guy never talks to people. I always thought he was mute.

say:5:1220360003:1.text: He's not mute! He just doesn't like to talk!
say:5:1220360003:1.source_cn: 人家可不是哑巴！只是不喜欢说话！

say:6:1220360004:1.source_cn: 对、对不起！我只是打个比方……

say:7:1220360005:1.text: We want to see Tucker. Where is he?
say:7:1220360005:1.source_cn: 我们想见塔克，他在哪里？

say:8:1220360006:1.text: The boss recently give him an important job. He seems to be very busy. I'm not sure what he's doing though.
say:8:1220360006:1.source_cn: 大当家最近委派了很重要的工作给他，他好像很忙，具体是什...

say:9:1220360007:0.text: If you take the lift up and walk around, you might run into him.
say:9:1220360007:0.source_cn: 你们坐电梯去上层的广场转转，有可能会碰到他。
say:9:1220360007:0.male: If you take the lift up and walk around, you might run into him.
say:9:1220360007:0.female: If you take the lift up and walk around, you might run into him.

say:2:1220362001:1.text: Tucker! How are you? We heard Sonja got you a new job.
say:2:1220362001:1.source_cn: 塔克！你还好吗？听说索尼娅给你安排了新的工作。

say:3:1220362002:1.text: Well, actually, Lucca found out what had happened and asked the boss to assign me this job.
say:3:1220362002:1.source_cn: 其实是卢卡二当家得知了事情的经过，他去拜托大当家给我安...

say:4:1220362003:1.text: The boss wants to protect the orphans wandering around Rustport. She's setting up an orphanage, and I'm helping.
say:4:1220362003:1.source_cn: 大当家想要好好保护在锈锚港流浪的孩子，她正在筹办孤儿院...

say:5:1220362004:1.text: Wow! Did you make this whole pot of stew? It smells delicious.
say:5:1220362004:1.source_cn: 哇，这一大锅都是你做的？看着不错嘛。

say:6:1220362005:1.text: Actually, my cooking is average, but luckily, these children aren't picky eaters.
say:6:1220362005:1.source_cn: 其实我的手艺不怎么样，幸好这些孩子不挑食。

say:7:1220362006:0.text: So the place behind you will become an orphanage in the future?
say:7:1220362006:0.source_cn: 你身后这地方，以后就是孤儿院了吗？

say:8:1220362007:1.text: The location hasn't been decided yet, so the children are living in tents for the time being. Just having a place to live is not enough. They have to find a way to support themselves.
say:8:1220362007:1.source_cn: 孤儿院的选址还没定，孩子们暂时只能住在帐篷里。光是有个...

say:9:1220362008:1.text: So, in addition to cooking for them, the boss asked me to teach them how to survive.
say:9:1220362008:1.source_cn: 除了给他们做饭，大当家还让我教他们一些生存技巧。

say:10:1220362009:0.text: As long as they can survive on their own, when they grow up, they'll be able to make something of themselves.
say:10:1220362009:0.source_cn: 只要能够靠自己生活下去，等他们长大，也就不再是海中漂泊...

say:13:1220362010:1.text: You seem to like children very much. I know you have a daughter. Have you ever thought about going back to see her?
say:13:1220362010:1.source_cn: 你好像很喜欢小孩子。我知道你有一个女儿，你想过回去见她吗？

say:14:1220362011:1.text: I-I'm too ashamed to see her. At least, I'm not ready yet.
say:14:1220362011:1.source_cn: 我……我没脸见她。起码现在还没有。

say:15:1220362012:1.text: Now, as I spend every day with these kids, I feel somewhat proud of what I do.
say:15:1220362012:1.source_cn: 现在每天和孩子们相处，我感觉自己的腰杆一点点直了起来。

say:16:1220362013:0.text: Maybe in a few years, I'll have the courage to go back and see Lily.
say:16:1220362013:0.source_cn: 说不定，在很多年以后，我会有勇气回去见莉莉。

say:17:1220362014:1.text: When I see her, I'll definitely tell her about the girl I met here...
say:17:1220362014:1.source_cn: 见到莉莉，我一定又会想起那个小姑娘吧……

say:18:1220362015:1.text: She has gone to a better place. You should live a good life so she doesn't worry about you.
say:18:1220362015:1.source_cn: 她一定去了很美的地方，你也要好好生活，别让她担心。

say:20:1220362017:0.text: By the way, it's so sunny today.
say:20:1220362017:0.source_cn: 话说回来……今天的太阳很暖和啊。

say:21:1220362018:1.text: I hope that girl is somewhere safe enjoying the nice, warm sunshine...
say:21:1220362018:1.source_cn: 也不知道她现在能不能享受到这份阳光？要是能……那就太好了。

say:4:1220363002:0.text: Gone? Did he leave the Carmine Whispers?

say:5:1220363003:1.text: He didn't really leave. How can I explain this...? Just think of it as him taking a long vacation.
say:5:1220363003:1.source_cn: 也不算离开，怎么和你说呢……你就当他请了个长假吧。

say:6:1220363004:1.text: Anyway, Lucca said that as long as he's willing to come back, we're ready to welcome him at any time.
say:6:1220363004:1.source_cn: 反正二当家说，只要他愿意回来，血薇帮随时欢迎他。

say:7:1220363005:0.text: Do you know where he went?
say:7:1220363005:0.source_cn: 你知不知道他去哪里了？

say:9:1220363007:1.text: He did say that he was going to look for a little girl. She seems to be some orphan wandering around Rustport.
say:9:1220363007:1.source_cn: 他只说自己要去找一个小女孩，好像是锈锚港附近流浪的孤儿。

say:10:1220363008:1.text: I don't know why he's so concerned about her. Maybe she looks like his daughter.
say:10:1220363008:1.source_cn: 也不知道他为什么对那孩子格外上心，可能是想起了自己的女儿吧，

say:11:1220363009:1.text: Look, I just joined, so I don't know much about Tucker. You may have nothing else to do, but I have work.
say:11:1220363009:1.source_cn: 我刚来没多久，对塔克不太了解。你要是没别的事，我先去干活了。

say:12:1220363010:0.text: Mr. Tucker went to look for the little girl... He's not going to find her...
say:12:1220363010:0.source_cn: 塔克先生去找那孩子了……这有什么意义……已经不可能找到了。
say:12:1220363010:0.male: Mr. Tucker went to look for the little girl... He's not going to find her...
say:12:1220363010:0.female: Mr. Tucker went to look for the little girl... He's not going to find her...

choice_prompt:13:1220363010.text: Mr. Tucker went to look for the little girl... He's not going to find her...
choice_prompt:13:1220363010.source_cn: 塔克先生去找那孩子了……这有什么意义……已经不可能找到了。
choice_prompt:13:1220363010.male: Mr. Tucker went to look for the little girl... He's not going to find her...
choice_prompt:13:1220363010.female: Mr. Tucker went to look for the little girl... He's not going to find her...

say:14:1220363011:1.text: If he finds her, it'll be a miracle. Fortunately, there is no shortage of miracles in Esperia.
say:14:1220363011:1.source_cn: 要是找到的话，一定是奇迹出现了。好在这个世界不缺乏奇迹。
say:14:1220363011:1.male: If he finds her, it'll be a miracle. Fortunately, there is no shortage of miracles in Esperia.
say:14:1220363011:1.female: If he finds her, it'll be a miracle. Fortunately, there is no shortage of miracles in Esperia.

say:15:1220363012:1.source_cn: 就让我们一起祝福他吧。

choice:13:0:1.text: Maybe he can. You never know.
choice:13:0:1.male: Maybe he can. You never know.
choice:13:0:1.female: Maybe he can. You never know.

say:17:1220363013:0.text: Do you mean something that will bring him peace?
say:17:1220363013:0.male: Do you mean something that will bring him peace?
say:17:1220363013:0.female: Do you mean something that will bring him peace?

say:18:1220363014:1.text: Well, he's not getting any younger. I hope he can find it soon...
say:18:1220363014:1.source_cn: 那家伙年纪也不小了，希望他早点找到啊！
say:18:1220363014:1.male: Well, he's not getting any younger. I hope he can find it soon...
say:18:1220363014:1.female: Well, he's not getting any younger. I hope he can find it soon...

say:0:1220364001:0.text: This barrel was knocked over. Judging from the direction, they ran that way.
say:0:1220364001:0.source_cn: 木桶被撞翻了。根据木桶翻倒的方向来看，它们往前跑了。
say:0:1220364001:0.male: This barrel was knocked over. Judging from the direction, they ran that way.
say:0:1220364001:0.female: This barrel was knocked over. Judging from the direction, they ran that way.

narration:0:1220366001:0.text: You go find Talbot, the fisherman, to give him the fish.
narration:0:1220366001:0.source_cn: 去找渔夫塔尔博特，把鱼给他吧
narration:0:1220366001:0.male: You go find Talbot, the fisherman, to give him the fish.
narration:0:1220366001:0.female: You go find Talbot, the fisherman, to give him the fish.

say:0:1220368001:0.text: Huh? That isn't Tucker. Have they replaced the guard?
say:0:1220368001:0.source_cn: 咦？那不是塔克，看守换人了吗？
say:0:1220368001:0.male: Huh? That isn't Tucker. Have they replaced the guard?
say:0:1220368001:0.female: Huh? That isn't Tucker. Have they replaced the guard?

say:2:1220348001:1.text: This is so strange... Where are her previous injuries?
say:2:1220348001:1.source_cn: 太奇怪了……她身上的伤呢？
say:2:1220348001:1.male: This is so strange... Where are her previous injuries?
say:2:1220348001:1.female: This is so strange... Where are her previous injuries?

say:3:1220348002:0.text: I remember her arms and her legs were all covered with burn scars. Where did they go...?
say:3:1220348002:0.source_cn: 我记得她的手臂、小腿、半张脸，全都是烧伤留下的丑陋疤痕...
say:3:1220348002:0.male: I remember her arms and her legs were all covered with burn scars. Where did they go...?
say:3:1220348002:0.female: I remember her arms and her legs were all covered with burn scars. Where did they go...?

choice_prompt:4:1220348002.text: I remember her arms and her legs were all covered with burn scars. Where did they go...?
choice_prompt:4:1220348002.source_cn: 我记得她的手臂、小腿、半张脸，全都是烧伤留下的丑陋疤痕。那些伤疤去哪了……
choice_prompt:4:1220348002.male: I remember her arms and her legs were all covered with burn scars. Where did they go...?
choice_prompt:4:1220348002.female: I remember her arms and her legs were all covered with burn scars. Where did they go...?

say:5:1220348003:0.text: Even with the help of magic, it's difficult to completely heal scars. I don't know what this is...
say:5:1220348003:0.source_cn: 即便是借助魔法，也很难让成型的伤疤彻底恢复。这到底是……
say:5:1220348003:0.male: Even with the help of magic, it's difficult to completely heal scars. I don't know what this is...
say:5:1220348003:0.female: Even with the help of magic, it's difficult to completely heal scars. I don't know what this is...

say:6:1220348004:1.text: I'm sure that's the little girl I met before.
say:6:1220348004:1.source_cn: 我可以肯定，那个小女孩就是我之前遇到的人。
say:6:1220348004:1.male: I'm sure that's the little girl I met before.
say:6:1220348004:1.female: I'm sure that's the little girl I met before.

say:7:1220348005:0.text: I'll never forget her eyes… They look just like my daughter's.
say:7:1220348005:0.source_cn: 我不会忘记她那双眼睛……她的眼神，和我女儿很像。
say:7:1220348005:0.male: I'll never forget her eyes… They look just like my daughter's.
say:7:1220348005:0.female: I'll never forget her eyes… They look just like my daughter's.

say:8:1220348006:0.text: I don't know the reason, but she doesn't want us to get too close...
say:8:1220348006:0.source_cn: 不知道为什么，她好像不希望我们靠近……
say:8:1220348006:0.male: I don't know the reason, but she doesn't want us to get too close...
say:8:1220348006:0.female: I don't know the reason, but she doesn't want us to get too close...

say:10:1220348007:0.text: Alright, let's go catch up with her first!
say:10:1220348007:0.source_cn: 总之，我们先去追上她吧！
say:10:1220348007:0.male: Alright, let's go catch up with her first!
say:10:1220348007:0.female: Alright, let's go catch up with her first!

cinematic_dialogue:13:1220349001:.text: You all went into the city again.
cinematic_dialogue:13:1220349001:.male: You all went into the city again.
cinematic_dialogue:13:1220349001:.female: You all went into the city again.

say:16:1220350001:0.source_cn: 她她她她……她在和那些老鼠说话！

say:17:1220350002:0.text: It's more than just talking to them. Did you see that, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Those rats are listening to her and doing everything she says!
say:17:1220350002:0.male: It's more than just talking to them. Did you see that, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Those rats are listening to her and doing everything she says!
say:17:1220350002:0.female: It's more than just talking to them. Did you see that, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Those rats are listening to her and doing everything she says!

say:18:1220350003:0.text: Until you explain what's going on, little girl, don't blame me for taking out my wand.
say:18:1220350003:0.source_cn: 小姑娘……在你解释清楚以前，不要怪我掏出法杖了！

say:21:1220350004:0.text: It's you all again... Why are you following me?!
say:21:1220350004:0.source_cn: 又是你们……为什么非要跟着我呢！
say:21:1220350004:0.male: It's you all again... Why are you following me?!
say:21:1220350004:0.female: It's you all again... Why are you following me?!

say:23:1220350005:0.text: Calm down, kid! They're good people! We want to help you!
say:23:1220350005:0.source_cn: 孩子，冷静点！他们是好人，我想帮你！

say:25:1220350007:0.text: Why are you with these monsters? We just want to know what's happening!
say:25:1220350007:0.source_cn: 你为什么和怪物在一起？我想知道发生了什么！

say:26:1220350008:1.text: Monster...? I'm not a monster! I don't want to hurt anyone!
say:26:1220350008:1.source_cn: 怪物……？我不是怪物！我不想伤害任何人！

say:27:1220350009:0.text: ... Mr. Tucker, don't come over here!

say:30:1220350010:1.text: Watch out, Magister! The rats are coming!
say:30:1220350010:1.source_cn: 主人！小心——那些老鼠围过来了！
say:30:1220350010:1.male: Watch out, Magister! The rats are coming!
say:30:1220350010:1.female: Watch out, Magister! The rats are coming!

cinematic_dialogue:33:1220349001:.text: You all went into the city again.
cinematic_dialogue:33:1220349001:.male: You all went into the city again.
cinematic_dialogue:33:1220349001:.female: You all went into the city again.

narration:35:12020376:0.text: You overhear that the girl is the leader of the giant rats and wish to question her, but she escapes again.
narration:35:12020376:0.source_cn: 你们偷听到女孩是巨鼠的指挥者，想要一问究竟，女孩却又一...

narration:36:12020376:0.text: You overhear that the girl is the leader of the giant rats and wish to question her, but she escapes again.
narration:36:12020376:0.source_cn: 你们偷听到女孩是巨鼠的指挥者，想要一问究竟，女孩却又一...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1220315001:.text: They went out of their way to go around the warehouse?
cinematic_dialogue:1:1220315001:.source_cn: 它们居然特意绕开了仓库？
cinematic_dialogue:1:1220315001:.male: They went out of their way to go around the warehouse?
cinematic_dialogue:1:1220315001:.female: They went out of their way to go around the warehouse?

cinematic_dialogue:1:1220347001:.text: Don't go! I have something to tell you!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1220347001:.male: Don't go! I have something to tell you!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1220347001:.female: Don't go! I have something to tell you!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1220347002:.text: Mr. Tucker? Don't come over here!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1220347002:.male: Mr. Tucker? Don't come over here!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1220347002:.female: Mr. Tucker? Don't come over here!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1220347001:.text: Don't go! I have something to tell you!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1220347002:.text: Uncle Tucker...? Don't come any closer!
